title: Ref
description: A typed edge in the corpus graph. See docs/corpus-spec.md#reference-edges.

from.description: URN of the citing or amending document, or the smallest containing part.

to.description: URN of the cited document. Null means the citation was extracted but did not resolve; raw is then required.

raw.description: The citation exactly as it appeared in the source text.

confidence.description: Below 1.0 means the edge was inferred rather than read. Surfaced in every MCP response that traverses it.

resolver.description: Name and version of the rule that produced this edge, e.g. statute_ref_v1.

then.description: An unresolved citation must preserve its raw string; it is a coverage metric, not a discard.
